visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a black T-shirt stands in front of a neutral grey background. He holds six rectangular cosmetic palettes in his hands, displaying a variety of blush shades toward the camera with an enthusiastic, open-mouthed expression. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a single Visee blush palette. The product features a dual-color design with a wavy texture. A hand is seen swiping the surface of the powder, demonstrating its shimmer and pigmentation against the light. (3) The man is shown applying the blush to his cheek using a small, white-bristled makeup brush. He turns his head to the side, showcasing the subtle pink glow on his skin. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the product's finish. (4) A rapid sequence of shots follows, each showcasing a different color palette from the collection, labeled PK1 through BR8. The man demonstrates the application of several shades, including pinks, oranges, and purples, alternating between full-face shots and extreme close-ups of the product. (5) The video concludes with the man smiling at the camera, holding a final palette near his face. He gestures with his hands in a playful manner, encouraging interaction, while the overall lighting remains consistent and professional.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase for the Visée blush collection. The creator uses a rapid, high-energy format to exhibit all eight shades in the line, providing both close-ups of the product texture and real-world application demos to illustrate how each color appears on skin. The intent is to drive brand awareness and encourage viewers to comment with their favorite shade.
